_status: TEMPORARY prototype values, approved 2026-11-23. Each one must be replaced by a measured value before real use (see _notes).

_notes.bearing_noise_deg_default: Starting value for the noise slider (standard deviation of simulated bearing error). Replace with the measured calibration error of the real cameras.
_notes.bearing_noise_deg_max: Upper end of the noise slider.
_notes.min_ray_angle_deg: If the widest angle between any two bearing lines is below this, the lines are too close to parallel and the result is rejected. Tune from simulation results.
_notes.max_range_m: A tower farther than this from the fire is treated as unable to see it, and estimates beyond this range are rejected. Roughly the city size; replace with the camera's real detection range.
_notes.ray_display_extend: Display only: bearing lines are drawn to this multiple of the distance to the estimate.
